svg.title: FairValue architecture
svg.desc: Research track: Transfermarkt tables, point-in-time dataset, feature matrix without demographics, nested cross-validation, held-out predictions, fairness audit joined with an audit-only lookup. Product track: final refit on all players, FastAPI, Next.js, which also reads the research export.
svg.text: FROM RAW TABLES TO AN AUDITED PRODUCT
Nationality exists only in the audit lookup. It never reaches a feature matrix, a model or the prediction API.
joined to held-out predictions only at audit time
Served full-data refits power the live
they are not the audited predictions.
